title: OECD Internship Programme
description: A paid internship at the OECD's headquarters in Paris (with some placements at affiliated bodies such as the International Energy Agency, Nuclear Energy Agency, Financial Action Task Force, or International Transport Forum), open to students enrolled in a fully accredited bachelor's, master's, or PhD degree programme for the entire duration of the internship. Internships run 1-6 months, renewable up to a total of 12 months, full-time. Interns receive a living allowance of approximately EUR 1,000/month for Paris-based placements. Internships are primarily allocated to nationals of OECD member countries, but some programmes and affiliated-body placements are open to non-OECD-member nationals as well. Applicants need excellent command of English or French (the OECD's two working languages) plus a working knowledge of, or willingness to learn, the other. Applications are accepted on an ongoing, rolling basis rather than against one fixed annual deadline.
org: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
visaNote: This is an internship, not employment; non-EU/EEA interns should confirm France's short-stay/internship visa requirements well ahead of the start date.
